subject.title: fix(workspace): prevent false Missing labels on existing files and fix panel layout overlap

question: Should `sessions.files.list` expose existence, size, and mtime for transcript-mentioned paths outside the workspace or fs-safe-rejected paths, or should those entries stay hidden, missing, or neutral behind the workspace boundary?
rationale: The PR changes a read-scoped Gateway file boundary, and the related issues/PRs show competing product directions: show external files as available, filter them out, or represent them without raw filesystem metadata.

options.title: Keep fs-safe boundary
options.body: Remove the raw stat fallback and use a boundary-preserving external or directory display state with tests for outside-root and fs-safe-rejected paths.

options.title: Allow external metadata deliberately
options.body: Accept the metadata exposure only with explicit maintainer/security approval, protocol expectations, and tests for absolute paths, symlinks, and directories.

options.title: Split layout from file semantics
options.body: Preserve or rely on the merged rail layout fix while leaving backend Missing semantics to the canonical linked issue.

recommendation.title: Keep fs-safe boundary
recommendation.body: Remove the raw stat fallback and use a boundary-preserving external or directory display state with tests for outside-root and fs-safe-rejected paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The most recent current-main boundary work centralizes this file access through fs-safe helpers, making this the best available owner for the security-boundary choice.
